# gcore_waap_domain_policies (Data Source)

WAAP security policies are the built-in protection rules of a domain. Each policy can be turned on or off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_waap_domain_policies" "example_waap_domain_policies" {
  domain_id = 1
  rule_set_id = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The domain ID

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `rule_set_id` (Number) Filter policies by rule set ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Specifies the action taken by the WAAP upon rule activation
Available values: "Allow", "Block", "Captcha", "Gateway", "Handshake", "Monitor", "Composite".
- `description` (String) Detailed description of the security rule
- `group` (String) The rule set group name to which the rule belongs
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the security rule
- `mode` (Boolean) Indicates if the security rule is active
- `name` (String) Name of the security rule
- `rule_set_id` (Number) Identifier of the rule set to which the rule belongs
